items.title: Italy's Meloni says Trump 'made up' story that she 'begged' him for photo at G7
items.description: The highly public exchange is an indication that their earlier close ties have frayed  since Trump's decision to go to war with Iran.

items.title: Do it at home too, women tell Japanese fans who cleaned World Cup stadium
items.description: Some see a double standard: Japanese men who clean in public while their wives do all the housework.

items.title: Zimbabwe MPs pass bill to extend president's time in power
items.description: The proposal would extend Emmerson Mnangagwa's term by two years and scrap direct presidential elections.

items.title: Morocco captain Achraf Hakimi to stand trial for rape
items.description: French prosecutors confirm Morocco captain Achraf Hakimi will stand trial for rape, in accusations dating back to 2023.

items.title: Asia's richest man Ambani announces what could be India's biggest share sale
items.description: India's largest telecom operator is expected to raise around $4bn (£3.02bn), according to media reports.

items.title: Boy, 12, wins hearts after trying to check sick chicken into Ethiopian hospital
items.description: Markos's beloved hen was not responding to any treatments - so he did the only thing he could think of.

items.title: UK actress charged with importing meth worth almost A$300m into Australia
items.description: Emaa Hussen, 34, faces life in prison for allegedly trying to smuggle 320kg of meth hidden in bags of charcoal.
